messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a wet reflective surface, slowly turning from a back view to a left profile and then back to facing away.","camera":"Static wide shot at roughly waist height, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"Sleeveless dark reddish-brown top, light lavender wide-leg pants, and dark strapped shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Short dark bob with a slight side part.","identity":"A slim female-presenting 3D character with a short bob haircut, seen mostly from behind.","scene":"A futuristic city plaza at dusk with a large glowing circular holographic display, neon-lit buildings, and a wet ground reflecting pink and blue lights."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a sunny fairground with a carousel and food stalls to a dark futuristic plaza with a large circular holographic display, neon buildings, and wet reflective ground. The character remains centered in a static wide shot and performs the same slow turn from back view to left profile and back. The character's lighting now shows pink/blue neon reflections, and the pants appear lavender under the new lighting.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source amusement-park scene with the reference futuristic city environment while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt the person's lighting to the new scene.
uncertain: Whether the hair color change is an unintended identity change or an acceptable lighting adaptation to the darker neon environment.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears darker in the output, closer to dark brown/black, compared with the lighter reddish-brown hair in the source.
